lines.text: Excuse me, I am going to Pine Station. Is this the right bus stop?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Usually, yes. Today the bus stops on Hill Street because this road is closed.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: How do I get to Hill Street from here? I need to catch a train at five.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Go past the bank and turn left. It is a five-minute walk to the stop.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Is the bus fast? It is already half past four, and I still need to buy a ticket.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: The bus takes twenty minutes. You can walk to the station in fifteen minutes through the park.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I will walk through the park, then. Is the park gate right after the bank?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, turn right after the bank for the park. Turn left for the bus stop.
lines.speaker: Eli
